title: Agentic AI
subtitle: A 6-week course on building autonomous AI agents, from a hand-written loop to multi-agent systems on MCP
time: 6 weeks, a project or two per week
blurb: Build agents by hand, then with the OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, LangGraph and more, and finish with a multi-agent system on MCP. Follows the syllabus of Ed Donner's agents course.
